title: Unapplied v1 support-manifest delta proposed by issue #837
not_applied_note: This file is a proposal only. The applied manifest registry/support/v1.json, its schema registry/support/schema/v1.json, and scripts/validate_support_manifest.py behavior are unchanged while this file remains unapplied.

changes.rationale: The census T3 tier (works, documented, no roadmap investment, honesty-mandatory) needs a manifest status that is not 'supported'. 'legacy_verified' records mechanical evidence of working-at-HEAD without implying investment. Applied together with the registry rename below so the two honest-support vocabularies match.

changes.change: rename flag verified -> legacy_verified on all 31 entries; both byte-identical copies change together in one commit
changes.rationale: Census row 14: 'verified: true' reads as a support claim; the honest support record is registry/support/v1.json. Pure honesty rename, no behavior change. Preferred follow-up (separate slice): derive one registry copy from the other to end dual-file drift.

changes.change: reason updated to note the example is community-tier documentation and is no longer auto-installed by the root dev dependency group (moved to an examples extra)
changes.rationale: Keeps the manifest reason consistent with the row-12 verdict; target_status development_only is already correct and does not change.

changes.change: reason updated to record the T2 internal-test-contract verdict and the packaging fix for the repo-only scripts/run_golden_path.py load
changes.rationale: The census contradicted the 'unconsumed' premise: 25 test files consume it. target_status development_only is unchanged; only the reason text becomes truthful.

non_changes: No gate status changes; gates.required and gates.status are untouched.
No surface is deleted, shimmed, or reclassified by this proposal; implementation belongs to #859/#860/#861.
Module-level surfaces (census rows 1-6 and 10) intentionally receive no manifest entity; their verdicts live in the decision record only.
